en.title: Tawḥīd, īmān and character: one religion
en.quote: Tawḥīd is the foundation; īmān requires obedience, and character shows itself in action.

bs.title: Tevhid, iman i ahlak: jedan din

fr.title: Tawḥīd, foi et caractère : une seule religion
